causal_hypothesis: Inconclusive between pregrasp misalignment and gripper/contact execution. Evidence supports a post-closure retention failure, but cannot uniquely identify the initiating layer.

critic_rules.proposal: Within 8cm of the observed pink target, closed jaws have sustained absent target contact, no retained grasp and no meaningful target lift for 12 physical actions. Interrupt and request one bounded open-settle-replan recovery.
critic_rules.title: Sustained post-closure noncontact and no retention

mechanism_change: Manual real deployment adaptation of the frozen sim candidate: gate post-closure failure to within 0.08m of the observed pink target; reserve 60 opening actions for the unchanged 0.08 step limit and 0.35 filter; use a 129-physical-action cooldown covering opening, settling and four 16-action VLA chunks. This is not an automatically learned or zero-shot unchanged candidate.

recovery_rules.fallback: If opening, settling verification, or Zeva replanning cannot establish its stated predicate within the bounded recovery horizon, invoke arx.finish with reason "alignment open-settle recovery exhausted".
recovery_rules.precondition: The critic has interrupted execution with gripper_closed=1, gripper_contact<=0.5, grasped=0, lift_m<=0.02, and success=0 sustained for its dwell window. The currently observed pink target must remain within 0.08m of the measured gripper during the 12-action dwell.
safety_constraints: Actor remains the sole environment writer; the critic only proposes interruption and recovery.

Do not recursively invoke this recovery during its 129-physical-action cooldown: up to 60 opening actions, 5 settling actions and 64 VLA actions. Read-only sensor refreshes do not consume cooldown or dwell.
Abort recovery if privileged.interaction.success becomes 1, the environment ends, or a safety supervisor interrupts.
Use only the frozen bounded tools and policy-inferred motion; provide no absolute coordinates.

steps.stop_when: The five-step settle window completes with privileged.interaction.gripper_closed at 0, privileged.interaction.grasped at 0, and privileged.interaction.success at 0.

After fresh measured open/unheld reentry review, complete up to four VLA chunks or stop on verified task success, termination, safety interruption or error. VLA may close jaws again as part of its approach and grasp.

recovery_rules.stop_condition: Stop on verified pink-target success or episode termination. VLA reentry requires fresh healthy synchronized feedback, measured arrival, clear critic, open right jaws, and false target contact, grasped and success features after the five-step hold.
recovery_rules.title: Open, verify settling, and freshly replan pregrasp

validation_plan: First verify far empty closure cannot trigger, 12 near-target physical actions can trigger, unknown observations break dwell, cooldown survives open-state transitions, and reopening converges under the unchanged actuator processor. In supervised real rollout record every physical action, feature, interruption, recovery step, reentry and pink-target success. No rescue attribution without verified success after interruption; no promotion from an untriggered recovery or a single trial.
